Golden Lentil Soup

A warm soup for cold evenings.

Ingredients

  • 1 cup red lentils
  • 2 large onions, chopped
  • 3 tbsp olive oil
  • a pinch of salt

Steps

  1. Rinse the lentils.
  2. Fry the onions in the oil until soft.
  3. Add the lentils and 1 litre of water and simmer for 20 minutes.
  4. Season with salt and serve.
